messages.subject: Adjusting position based on group
parts:
Hi all,
This question is inspired by Alistair's recent post, but sufficiently
more general that I thought a new thead was appropriate.

Position adjustments operate at the level of each individual geom. For example:

dat <- data.frame(x=factor(rep(1:3, each=10)), y=rnorm(30 ),
z=factor(rep(1:2, 15 ) ))
pl <- ggplot(dat, aes(x, y, color=z))
pl + geom_point(position=position_dodge(width=0.5))

appears to dodge each point.

Is there a way to adjust the postion at the level of the group
"aesthetic"? That is, instead of dodging each point, I would like two
columns of points, one for each level of z.

Best,
Ista


--
Ista Zahn
Graduate student
University of Rochester
Department of Clinical and Social Psychology
